import Mathlib
open scoped BigOperators
theorem study_a_log_product (x y : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) : Real.log (x * y) = Real.log x + Real.log y := by
  exact Real.log_mul hx hy
